title: Tasklet · product flow map
subtitle: Example output of the mapping-product-flows skill on a fictional app. Every node is a real screenshot of the demo pages; the e-mails and the identity provider are part of the journeys.
findings: "Forgot password?" leads to a 404: an account that loses its password cannot be recovered (UC-ACC-04).
The identity provider shows auth.tasklet-infra.example instead of Tasklet on the account chooser (UC-ACC-02).
